content: Tarwa n Ibrahim
Iksi Ibrahim tamɣart nneɣni, qqaren as Qatura.
Netta turuw as-dd Zimran, Yaqcan, Midyan, Yicbaq d Cuḥa.
Yuqcan ijja-dd Caba d Dadan. Uca arrawen n Dadan tuɣa aten d Iccuriyyen d Ilituciyyen d Iliyumiyyen.
Iḥenjiren n Midyan tuɣa aten d Ɛiyfa, Ɛifar, Ḥanux, Abidaɛ d Aldaɛa. Marra ina tuɣa aten d iḥenjiren n Qaṭura.
Ibrahim iwca marra min ɣares i Isḥaq.
Maca i iḥenjiren n tiyya i tuɣa ɣar Ibrahim, iwca asen Ibrahim arriɣalut uca, am t tuɣa ɛad iddar, issekk i-ten ssenni ɣar ccarq, ɣar temmurt n ccarq, issiggʷej i-ten x Isḥaq mmis.
Ibrahim tuɣa iddar mya u-xemsa u-sebɛin n iseggʷusa, wa d řmijař n tudart nnes.
Iḍřeq Ibrahim i buḥbeř nnes uca immut di ccib isegged, di tewsar d tyawant. Uca immarni ɣar řgens nnes.
Isḥaq d Ismaɛil, iḥenjiren nnes, neḍřen t deg ifri n Makfila deg iyyar n Ɛifrun, mmis n Ṣuḥar, Aḥitti, iyyar i iǧan qibač i Mamri.
Ittwanḍeř Ibrahim d temɣart nnes Sara deg iyyar nni isɣa Ibrahim zi tarwa n Ḥit.
Awarni i řmewt n Ibrahim ibarek AREBBI mmis Isḥaq. Uca izdeɣ Isḥaq zzat i wanu n Laḥay-Ru’i.
Ina d imezruyen n yinni dd-ittwaxeřqen zi Ismaɛil, mmis n Ibrahim, inni dd-tejja Hajar, tayya n Sara zi Miṣra, i Ibrahim.
D yina d ismawen n iḥenjiren n Ismaɛil, s ismawen nsen ɛlaḥsab axřaq nsen. Amenzu n Ismaɛil tuɣa-t d Nabayut, xenni Qidar, Adbiyil, Mibsam,
Misma, Duma, Massa,
Ḥadar, Tayma, Yaṭur, Nafic d Qidma.
D yina d iḥenjiren n Ismaɛil s ismawen nsen, s dcurat nsen d řmarageḥ nsen: tenɛac n řḥukkam s řaǧat nsen.
Tuɣa iddar Ismaɛil mya u-sebɛa u-třatin n iseggʷusa. Xenni iḍřeq Ismaɛil i buḥbeř nnes, immut uca immarni ɣar řgens nnes.
Nitni zeddɣen zi Ḥawila ɣar Cur, wenni iǧan arendad n Miṣra, am tᵉṭṭfed abrid ɣar Accur. Netta izdeɣ arendad n marra aytmas.
Ina d imezruyen n yinni dd-ittwaxeřqen zi Isḥaq, mmis n Ibrahim.
Yaɛqub d Ɛisu
Ibrahim ijja-dd Isḥaq.
Tuɣa ɣar Isḥaq arebɛin n iseggʷusa umi yiwi Rifqa d tamɣart. Nettat d yeǧis n Bituwil, Aramiyu zi Faddan-Aram, učmas n Laban, Aramiyu.
Iḥeccem Isḥaq SIDI di ṭṭweɛ n temɣart nnes, tenni tuɣa war ittirwen ca, uca istajeb as SIDI s tẓaǧit nnes yuǧɣen, ařami teksi temɣart nnes, Rifqa, ddeyset.
Uca mmdeḥsen iḥenjiren deg uɛeddis nnes. Xenni tenna: “Manawya ɛawed, mayemmi d ayi ittemsar man aya?”, uca truḥ ad tesseqsa SIDI.
Inna as SIDI: “Aqa din tnayen n řegnus di ddeyset nnem u tnayen n ccuɛub ad mmsebḍan zi dwaxeř nnem. Ijj n cceɛb ad yiři ijhed x cceɛb nneɣni u wenni d amenzu ad ixdem i umaẓuẓ.”
Ařami dd-iwḍen wussan nnes ad taru, xzar, aqa da deg uɛeddis nnes acniwen.
Iffeɣ-dd umezwar. Tuɣa-t d azeggʷaɣ, iceɛɛar qaɛ am yict n thiḍurt. S uyenni ggin as Ɛisu.
Awarni as iffeɣ-dd umas. Iṭṭef afus nnes deg unirz n Ɛisu. S uya semman t s yisem Yaɛqub. Tuɣa ɣar Isḥaq settin n iseggʷusa ɣar wexřaq nsen.
Řami gman iḥenjiren, idweř Ɛisu d ijj n weryaz issen aneymar, ijj n weryaz n barra, maca Yaɛqub idweř d ijj n weryaz yarsa, wenni izeddɣen deg iqiḍan.
Isḥaq tuɣa ittexs Ɛisu, minzi iɛjeb as ad yecc aysum n řmař n řexřa, u Rifqa tuɣa tᵉttexs Yaɛqub.
Uca issnenni Yaɛqub ict n macca, umi dd-iɛqeb Ɛisu zi řexřa, yuḥeř.
Inna Ɛisu i Yaɛqub: “Ttzawgeɣ cek ad ayi tewced ad cceɣ zeg uzeggʷaɣ, azeggʷaɣ nni diha, maɣar aqa fniɣ s ufadi.” X uya qqaren as ‘Idum’.
Řexdenni inna Yaɛqub: “Zenz ayi ass-a řḥeqq nnec n umenzu.”
Inna Ɛisu: “Xzar, aqa necc ad mmteɣ, min ɣa ggeɣ s řḥeqq n umenzu?”
Xenni inna Yaɛqub: “Jaǧ ayi řexxu!” Uca ijjuǧ as, izzenz i Yaɛqub řḥeqq n umenzu nnes.
Xas uca iwca Yaɛqub i Ɛisu aɣrum d umecři n řeɛdes, u Ɛisu icca, iswa, ikkar, iruḥ. Ammu isseḥqar Ɛisu řḥeqq n umenzu nnes.
